selection_rule: Choose the variant with the highest mean wBA over the 5 dev datasets x 4 classifiers (each dataset = mean of 5x2 CV folds). Tie (difference < 0.002): higher mean G-mean. The chosen variant is then run ONCE on the 10 held-out datasets with no further changes.
honesty_note: SMOTE, AW-SMOTE and RC-AW-SMOTE results on all 15 datasets were already seen before this split. New variants are developed only on the dev datasets.
chosen_variant: V7 V4 with global SMOTE partners
development_rounds: Round 1: V0-V6. Round 2 (after seeing round-1 dev results): V7, V8. Then stopped.
